title: Signal Over the South Bay: Creatures of the South Bay
fiction: Companion to an original comic. Items tagged REAL are real South Bay species, places or phenomena; items tagged INVENTED belong to the comic's fictional world and are not real ecology.

items.name: Brown Pelican
items.description: A big gray-brown seabird that glides in lines just above the waves. It plunges headfirst into the water to scoop fish into its throat pouch.
items.fun_fact: Brown pelicans were taken off the U.S. endangered species list in 2009 after the pesticide DDT was banned.

items.name: Harbor Seal
items.description: A spotted, round-headed seal that hauls out on rocks and jetties to rest. It holds a curved banana pose to keep its head and flippers off the cold rock.
items.fun_fact: Harbor seals have no external ear flaps, which is how you tell them from sea lions.

items.name: California Sea Lion
items.description: A sleek brown marine mammal that barks from buoys and breakwaters. It swims fast and loves to surf waves.
items.fun_fact: Sea lions can rotate their back flippers forward to walk on land; seals can't.

items.name: Bottlenose Dolphin
items.description: A gray dolphin that cruises just past the surf line in small pods. Coastal pods along the bay are often seen from the pier.
items.fun_fact: Coastal bottlenose dolphins sometimes surf the same waves as the people on the beach.

items.name: Western Snowy Plover
items.description: A tiny sand-colored shorebird that runs along the beach on twinkling legs. It nests in shallow scrapes right on open sand.
items.fun_fact: It is federally threatened, which is why some beaches fence off quiet nesting areas each spring.

items.name: Pacific Gray Whale
items.description: A huge mottled gray whale that passes the South Bay each winter and spring on its migration. Watchers look for its heart-shaped spout.
items.fun_fact: Its round-trip migration between Alaska and Baja California is among the longest of any mammal, more than 10,000 miles.

items.name: Garibaldi
items.description: A bright orange fish that patrols the kelp forest and rocky reefs. It is bold and will chase divers off its territory.
items.fun_fact: It is California's official state marine fish, and males tend nests of red algae.

items.name: Leopard Shark
items.description: A slender, gentle shark marked with dark saddles and spots. It cruises shallow, sandy water and bays.
items.fun_fact: Leopard sharks are harmless to people and gather in warm shallows to rest.

items.name: Great Blue Heron
items.description: A tall gray-blue wading bird that stands perfectly still in the marsh, then spears fish with its bill. It nests in tall trees.
items.fun_fact: Herons also hunt gophers and mice in fields, standing just as patiently as they do in water.

items.name: Belding's Savannah Sparrow
items.description: A small streaky sparrow that lives year-round in pickleweed salt marsh. Males sing from the tops of the plants.
items.fun_fact: It is state-listed as endangered and depends almost entirely on pickleweed marsh like Ballona's.

items.name: Western Gull
items.description: The big white-and-gray gull of the California coast, with pink legs and a yellow bill. It nests on islands and rooftops.
items.fun_fact: The red spot on its bill is a target: chicks peck it to ask their parents for food.

items.name: California Least Tern
items.description: A small, fast tern with a black cap and yellow bill that dives for little fish. It nests in colonies on open sand.
items.fun_fact: It is federally endangered; a protected colony nests on the beach at Venice.

items.name: Peregrine Falcon
items.description: A powerful falcon that nests on cliffs and tall buildings and hunts pigeons in midair. It has made a big comeback.
items.fun_fact: In a hunting dive it can top 200 miles per hour, the fastest of any animal.

items.name: Allen's Hummingbird
items.description: A tiny copper-and-green hummingbird that zips through coastal gardens. Males perform swooping dive displays.
items.fun_fact: At the bottom of its dive, the male's tail feathers make a sharp buzzing trill.

items.name: Western Fence Lizard
items.description: A spiny gray-brown lizard that does push-ups on fences and rocks. Males flash blue belly patches.
items.fun_fact: Its blood contains a protein that kills the Lyme disease bacteria in ticks that bite it.

items.name: Long-beaked Common Dolphin
items.description: A sleek dolphin with an hourglass pattern of tan and gray on its sides. It travels in big, splashy groups offshore.
items.fun_fact: Common dolphins sometimes gather in superpods of a thousand or more.

items.name: Red-tailed Hawk
items.description: A big broad-winged hawk that soars over freeways and parks and perches on light poles. Adults show a rusty red tail.
items.fun_fact: Its raspy scream is the one movies dub over bald eagles.

items.name: Urban Coyote
items.description: A lean, tawny wild dog that slips through neighborhoods and bluffs at dawn and dusk. It eats rodents, fruit and whatever it finds.
items.fun_fact: Coyotes have lived alongside Los Angeles for its whole history and are found in every part of the county.

items.name: Virginia Opossum
items.description: A gray, white-faced night wanderer with a naked tail, common in backyards. It eats insects, snails and fallen fruit.
items.fun_fact: It is North America's only marsupial; babies ride in a pouch, then on their mother's back. Ratchet, the refinery mascot in the cast, is one.

items.name: Mach
items.description: Capt. Della Marsh's beagle, who naps under the Gull's wing during preflight checks. Mach howls along with the engine run-up.
items.fun_fact: Invented character pet: Mach was the first to the hangar door on the night the Lantern went dark.

items.name: Sputnik
items.description: Rusty Vance's orange tabby, who rides in his tool belt pouch and sleeps on the warm radio chassis. Sputnik hates spacewalks.
items.fun_fact: Invented character pet: named for the beeping satellite; purrs at exactly the station carrier frequency, Rusty insists.

items.name: Carrier
items.description: The cockatiel who lives in the Lantern's broadcast booth and whistles the station chime. She mimics every engineer's voice.
items.fun_fact: Invented character pet: Carrier whistled the 6:45 chime on time even during the blackout.

items.name: Crumb
items.description: The calico who sleeps in the front window of the Starliner Diner on Main Street. Regulars greet her before they order.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet: she sits on the newspaper stack every morning until the delivery arrives.

items.name: Buoy
items.description: The yellow Lab who rides along in the lifeguard truck. Buoy greets every surfer coming out of the water.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet: Buoy is the honorary captain of the junior lifeguards and off-duty pal of Biscuit, the beach patrol dog.

items.name: Dinghy
items.description: The pug who waddles the length of the pier every evening with her owner. Fishermen save her a sardine.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet: Dinghy snores louder than the foghorn, say the regulars at the bait shop.

items.name: Old Ironsides
items.description: A desert tortoise who has lived in the Rec Park garden for decades. Kids feed him dandelions on Saturdays.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet; real desert tortoises are California's state reptile and protected, so adopted ones need a permit.

items.name: Countdown
items.description: The goldfish in the bowl on the Aero Works control room console. Engineers tap the glass for luck before every launch.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet: Countdown was the only one in Sam Abernathy's control room who didn't panic at 4:12 A.M.

items.name: Hopalong
items.description: The library rabbit who lives behind the children's desk at the town library and visits classrooms. Hopalong loves carrot tops.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet: Hopalong's ears twitch whenever the radio is switched on.

items.name: Kahuna
items.description: The corgi who rides the nose of a longboard on small summer days. Kahuna has his own fan club at the pier.
items.fun_fact: Invented town pet: he only surfs when the morning edition says two to three feet.

items.name: Rivet
items.description: A riveted chrome terrier built at the Aero Works as a shop mascot. It fetches wrenches and barks in Morse code.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: its tail is a tiny antenna that wags faster when the signal is strong.

items.name: Bleep
items.description: A gull-shaped hover drone that drops a rolled paper onto porches when the radio isn't enough. Kids wave to it on the way to school.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: Bleep delivers in a perfect line and never misses a porch, except Rusty's.

items.name: Tin Pelican
items.description: A lifeguard rescue drone with a pelican's pouch that drops a float to swimmers in trouble. It patrols on busy weekends.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: modeled on the real brown pelican's plunge dive.

items.name: Dial
items.description: A wind-up clockwork cat that keeps time for the station's transmitter room. It purrs with a ticking sound.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: Dial's eyes show the hour and minute hands.

items.name: Hermie
items.description: A little robotic hermit crab that combs the sand for litter and leaves the wrack line alone. It carries its finds in a tin shell.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: programmed to skip plover nests and sea glass.

items.name: Echo
items.description: A bat-winged drone that flies grid lines at night to map the Lantern's signal. Its wings are thin antenna mesh.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: Echo found the dead spot over the bay before anyone else.

items.name: Patch
items.description: A ladybug-size robot that pollinates Main Street window boxes. It hums softly from flower to flower.
items.fun_fact: Invented robo-pet: it gives real bees the right of way.

items.name: Moon Moth
items.description: An invented pale moth that flutters on the solar wind and is drawn to the Lantern's beacon. Swarms circle the mast on quiet nights.
items.fun_fact: Invented: the night of the blackout, they drifted off toward the moon with the beam.

items.name: Orbit Jelly
items.description: An invented jellyfish-like drifter that floats in the high orbit around the Lantern, glowing teal and orange. It feeds on stray radio light.
items.fun_fact: Invented: Rusty keeps a photo of one taped to his console; Lumen, from the cast, is the famous one who talks.

items.name: Static Sprite
items.description: Invented spark-size creatures that skitter across the Lantern's dish. They are harmless and make the dish twinkle.
items.fun_fact: Invented: engineers count them the way sailors count stars.

items.name: Comet Koi
items.description: An invented orange-and-white fish shape that swims through meteor showers, trailing a glittering tail. It is seen only from orbit.
items.fun_fact: Invented: spotting one is good luck for the morning's signal.
